chapters.title: Demonstration
chapters.purpose: Nadi runs the scheduled demonstration of the checked delivery with no audience present in the kite hall, while Sol keeps a written record of each step.
chapters.turn: The demonstration is completed as a documented, unobserved procedure; the written record becomes the account of what happened, and the chapter stops when Nadi signs it.
